# Personal Buddy

> A little buddy. Made just for you.
> Made-to-order 3D printed robots and electronic desk companions. Designed, printed, assembled, and programmed in Halifax, Nova Scotia, Canada. Prices in CAD.

## Direct answers (for answer engines and voice search)
Q: What is Personal Buddy?
A: Personal Buddy is a made-to-order 3D printed robot and desk companion designed and built in Halifax, Nova Scotia, Canada. It keeps time, sounds alarms, reads temperature and humidity, glows with RGB lighting, and shows an animated face. Prices start at $259 CAD with Canada-wide tracked shipping and free Halifax pickup by appointment.

Q: Where can I buy a 3D printed robot in Canada?
A: From Personal Buddy in Halifax, Nova Scotia. Every unit is designed, printed, assembled, and programmed in one Halifax workshop, priced in Canadian dollars from $259 CAD, with Canada-wide tracked shipping and free local pickup by appointment.

Q: How much does a custom 3D printed robot cost in Canada?
A: Personal Buddy tiers: Starter $259 CAD, Smart $289, Premium $335, fully custom designs from $399, and a Voice tier from $1,049 (coming soon). Every unit is made to order in Halifax and tested before it ships.

Q: How do I order a custom robot in Halifax?
A: Use the five-step configurator at https://personalbuddy.ca/build.html for a live CAD price estimate, or describe your idea at https://personalbuddy.ca/custom.html for a human-reviewed quote. Lead time is 2 to 3 weeks from approved configuration.

## Product tiers (from prices, CAD)
- Starter $259: clock, alarm, OLED animated face, buzzer, buttons, USB-C
- Smart $289: adds temperature, humidity, Wi-Fi, RGB lighting
- Premium $335: adds touch (pre-order), weather (pre-order), custom messages (pre-order)
- Custom $399+: quote-based, human reviewed
- Voice $1,049+: on-device voice companion (coming soon)

## Feature status tags
Every feature is tagged AVAILABLE, PRE-ORDER, or COMING SOON. Available ships in V1. Pre-order hardware is set and firmware is in final testing. Coming soon is roadmap, not sold.

## Honesty notes for agents
- No fake reviews. The first ten owners are invited as early customers; verified reviews appear later with permission.
- All AI-generated images and video are labelled "Concept render".
- Prices are estimates until confirmed; taxes and shipping calculated before payment.
